<h1>
  <span class="headline">Universal resources</span>
</h1>

Shared General Assembly theme files (fonts, CSS, JavaScript, logos and the `template.pkl` that defines `config.json`)
used by every page of this site. They were copied unchanged (apart from three empty README.md placeholders) from the `static/v2` folder of the
`universal-resources-internal` module in the Deloitte AI Solution Architect course repository.

**Please do not edit or remove anything in this folder.** To update the theme, replace `static/v2` with the new version.
